ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs

- Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly

- Over $300 million raised in funding

- Over 2,800 Tideans globally

- We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Our team guides businesses through the early stages of their journey in the funding market. We work with SMEs that have just begun operating and aren't yet sure what they're eligible for. Our main goal is to educate them and nurture a long-lasting relationship - so that as their business grows, our offerings grow with them

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This customer-facing role will focus on understanding the requirements of our customers and assisting them through the journey to find the best financial solution, ensuring that all of our customers have delightful, memorable experiences.

Some of the things you’ll be doing:

- Managing inbound communications from our customers

- Proactively contact prospective customers exploring finance options on our website and inbound enquiries

- Ensuring all customers are supported through our digital journey with a successful outcome of securing the funds they require

- Deal assistance; working with Lenders at each stage of the sales process

- Confidently pitch lending products on behalf of our panel of lenders most suitable for our customers

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date information on any prospects that you speak with (in Salesforce)

- Monitoring and identify trends & anticipate needs to help you identify quality businesses who would need Funding Options whilst adding new or updated customer profile information into Salesforce

- Ensuring that sales technologies, such as our CRM, are used accurately, promptly and correctly to enable effective data collation and reporting

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- An obsession for delivering the highest level of customer service, along with superior communications skills

- Ability to engage and quickly establish strong working relationships

- A results-oriented work ethic with impeccable attention to detail, determination and drive

- A passion for small businesses and helping them achieve their dreams

- Ability and desire to work in a fast-paced environment and effectively engage with Customers to understand their customer’s requirements/needs so you can guide them to the solution

- Work well independently as well as collaboratively with the wider business

- You are self-motivated and have the ability to manage and to plan your day.

- Ability to work well under pressure

- Ability to troubleshoot issues quickly and effectively

- Experience working on the telephones - sales or call centre based environments

- Works effectively in virtual teams with colleagues, customers, suppliers and others

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

- Salary: €16,400.00 - €18,450.00 gross annual

- 25 days paid annual leave

- 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities

- Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company

- Personal L&D budget in the amount of 250 EUR per year (can be increased)

- Additional health & dental insurance

- Mental wellbeing platform

- Fully covered Multisports card

- Food vouchers

- WFH equipment allowance

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.

Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.

Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.

For more information visit cultureamp.com.

How you can help make a better world of work

Culture Amp's revenue engine runs on deals that close cleanly and on data that's easy to trust. As a Revenue Specialist on our Revenue Operations team, you'll help make sure every closed-won deal in Salesforce actually holds up: right terms, right approvals, right paperwork.

You'll work closely with Sales, Finance, Legal and Revenue Operations to keep deals moving and to catch small issues before they become big ones, learning the ins and outs of our quote-to-cash process along the way. It's a great role for someone early in their RevOps or Sales Ops career who's genuinely curious about how a sales org works end to end, and who takes real satisfaction in getting the details right.

You will

- Audit closed-won deals in Salesforce to confirm commercial terms, approvals, pricing, products, contract details and documentation are accurate and complete, and route errors back to the deal owner for correction

- Work hands-on in DealHub CPQ: help reps build and troubleshoot quotes, learn to read and explain approval and validation logic, and understand how quote configuration flows through to the Service Order and into Salesforce

- Own and resolve day-to-day Deal Desk tickets in Salesforce, applying documented commercial policy to give Sales clear, practical guidance on structuring compliant agreements

- Partner with Account Executives, Sales leadership, Finance, Legal and Revenue Operations to resolve deal issues and keep opportunities moving

- Help spot recurring deal-quality issues and process gaps, flagging patterns to your manager and Revenue Operations leadership, and contribute ideas for improving Deal Desk workflows — escalating any system configuration work to GTM Systems and our Quote-to-Cash Systems Lead

You have

- 2+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations or a similar role supporting a SaaS sales organisation

- A working understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash process: opportunity management, approvals, pricing, contracting and handoff to downstream teams

- A track record of reviewing sales transactions with attention to detail, sound judgement and a commitment to accuracy and compliance

- Strong Salesforce skills, including managing tickets, reviewing opportunity data and keeping sales records accurate and complete

- Good business partnering and communication skills, comfortable explaining policy clearly and resolving issues with a customer-focused mindset

- Familiarity with a CPQ platform such as DealHub, Salesforce CPQ or similar; you don't need to be an expert, but you're comfortable enough to configure a quote, diagnose why one is stuck, and know when to loop in a system owner

You are

- Curious and detail-oriented, comfortable digging into data to spot patterns

- Organized, with a good instinct for following the right process without overcomplicating things

- A natural collaborator who's comfortable working across Sales, Finance and Legal, and asking questions when something's unclear

For this role, the estimated base salary range is listed below. In addition to base salary, your compensation package will include additional components such as equity and benefits. For sales roles, your package may also include sales commission

The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual skills, capabilities and experience, objectively assessed during the interview process. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We believe in fair & equitable pay at Culture Amp, and therefore, we build pay equity into all our programs in addition to conducting annual pay equity audits.

Base Salary Range (US)
$99,000—$113,000 USD

Perks & Benefits

At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success. We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life. This includes:

- Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long-term success

- Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow

- Quarterly refresh days, an extended end-of-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle

- Inclusive parental leave from day one

- A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility

- Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you

- Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US & UK only)

Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters. If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.

Accommodations & Data Privacy

If you require reasonable accommodations or adjustments due to a disability to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@cultureamp.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Culture Amp will retain your CV & personal information for a period of two years (four years for the US) from the date of your application process completion. Culture Amp may contact you in relation to future job opportunities during this time period. For further information please see our privacy policy here or contact privacy@cultureamp.com.

Construire et faire vivre notre data people

construire des tableaux de bord pour les managers et l’équipe People ;

-
consolider des données venant de plusieurs outils : Hibob, Silae, Elevo, Google Sheets, LMS, etc. ;

-
fiabiliser les données et identifier les incohérences ;

-
automatiser des reportings, exports ou contrôles récurrents tout en les rendants facilement maintenables pour le futur ;

-
aider les managers à lire et utiliser la data people sans créer d’usine à gaz ;

-
traduire un besoin opérationnel parfois flou en indicateurs utiles.

Piloter des projets People Ops / outils

piloter ou contribuer au déploiement d’outils ;

-
automatiser ce qui peut l’être ;

documenter clairement les règles et bonnes pratiques ;

travailler avec les équipes People, les managers, le groupe et les équipes opérationnelles.

Aider sur l’admin / paie

tu as une expérience solide, au moins 7 ans, en People Analytics, HRIS, People Ops, projets people, paie / ADP, outils SIRH ;

tu comprends les grands enjeux people opérationnels ;

tu as envie de faire autrement, dans une culture forte d’autonomie et de responsabilité.

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Visual Designer to join our Website Design Engineering team. Your home base is Vercel's web presence, vercel.com, nextjs.org, product launches, and Ship, where you'll design pages, systems, and interactions that get built and shipped, not just handed off. But the impact is bigger than the site: you'll shape how the Vercel brand shows up in the world, from launch moments and event experiences to motion, illustration, and brand-partnership surfaces across digital and physical mediums. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with design engineers who turn design into production code, so your work lives on the real web at Vercel's bar for polish.

This is a role for a designer who thinks in systems and sweats the details: someone equally at home setting the typographic rhythm of a landing page, and shaping how a tier-one hero feels on first load.

First and foremost, this is a visual design role. Exceptional creativity and design craft for the web are what matter most. Our design engineers own turning design into production code, and you're encouraged to get hands-on in the medium yourself and carry an idea all the way to production when you want to. - Define the visual language of Vercel's most-seen surfaces, vercel.com, nextjs.org, product launches, and Ship, and set a creative direction the whole team builds from.

- Create the moments people remember: hero animations, launch films, event environments, and brand-partnership work that reaches across screen and physical space.

- Own the creative vision end to end, from the first spark of a concept to the finished result shipped on the real web, alongside design engineers who turn your work into production code.

- Set the craft bar: the typography, motion, and detail that make a page unmistakably Vercel, the kind of work other teams measure themselves against.

- Move fluidly across mediums, web, motion, illustration, 3D, and identity, and raise the bar wherever the Vercel brand shows up.

- Leave a mark on the system: influence Geist and our shared patterns through work good enough to become the standard.

- Above all, a distinctive eye and original ideas. Exceptional visual design instincts and creativity are the heart of this role, and the web is where most of your work will live.

- A portfolio spanning brand systems and work across multiple digital and physical mediums, anchored by strong, shipped web work. 8+ years of design experience.

- Meaningful hands-on range across several of these: motion, 3D, illustration, environmental and event design, and interaction. This is a maker's role, and coding is not what we mean by hands-on.

- Systems-minded: you design components and patterns, not one-offs, and think about how each choice fits a broader system.

- You've shaped launch moments, events, or brand-partnership surfaces under real deadlines, and you know how to make a moment land.

- You thrive collaborating with engineers and understand the web as a medium: how layouts behave, what's buildable, how design becomes code.

- Comfortable in a technology-driven environment; experience with developer, B2B, or SaaS products is a plus.

- A self-starter and egoless collaborator who takes feedback well and gives it generously.

- Familiar with Vercel, with working knowledge or experience preferred.

Bonus If You:

- Can prototype or bring ideas to life in code (React / Tailwind / Next.js).

- Have contributed to a design system at scale (even if owning ours won't be your job).

Benefits:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.

- Inclusive Healthcare Package.

- Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

- Flexible Time Off.

- We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

What's the opportunity?

With the advent of AI, the nature of customer support has changed dramatically - as have the humans who provide it. Our next Technical Support Specialist will be someone who thrives in autonomy, is deeply curious, fluent in AI tools and holds an extremely high bar not just for themselves, but for their teammates.

As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll own complex technical queries around some of our most nuanced features, serve as a point of escalation for your colleagues for the most tricky investigations, consistently provide world class customer support, collaborate with our customers proactively to help them make the most of our platform and help drive improvements in product, processes, and peer development. You'll use AI tools alongside your own expertise to handle complex cases efficiently and play a role in shaping a culture of continuous improvement. We ship product updates consistently, so if constant learning excites and energises you, this environment will suit you well!

If this is the kind of role that excites you, then we want you as our next Technical Support Specialist.

What will I be doing?

- Communicating efficiently and effectively with our customers - we use our own product to do most of our support, but outbound phone calls are part of our offering too.

- Owning customer communications and issues from initial contact until resolution.

- Becoming an encyclopedia of knowledge about how Fin works and what it is capable of.

- Being the one responsible, along with the Support team, to ensure that all customers have a great experience with the product - a crucial part of the role is ensuring we make the product as easy to use, reliable, bug-free, and fast as possible.

- Working directly with product teams to identify current issues and, synthesizing the diverse feedback you hear from our customers, offer informed opinions on potential solutions.

- Debugging complex issues with an understanding of both our own codebase and the many technologies employed by our customers.

- Utilizing inherited and learned technical knowledge to build tools that will help increase the efficiency and effectiveness of the team and its processes.

- Influencing the direction of the Fin product through daily communication with our customers and consistent collaboration with our product teams.

What your first 6 months will look like:

In your first 30 days you will:

- Complete company onboarding, becoming familiar with Fin's values, strategy, and goals.

- Dive into CS-specific trainings to learn the product and CS workflows and successfully pass relevant assessments.

- Start talking to customers in the inbox and build “inboxing” fundamentals through Paired Inboxing sessions.

- Showcase successful and proactive communication about your training progress and needs/questions that arise.

In your first 60 days, you will:

- Continue to complete CS trainings and pass relevant assessments successfully and on schedule.

- Independently inbox using the resources and supports provided; be able to identify Problems to be Solved and address all pieces of the customer’s query.

- Demonstrate ownership in the execution of your work.

- Showcase successful and proactive communication, building on above - begin a habit of having items prepared for 1:1 discussion and driving the agenda.

In your first 90 days, you will:

- Receive QA reviews and action feedback.

- Begin a personal growth tracker document (or Individual Development Plan) with your manager for ongoing development and showcase a proactive approach to personal and career development.

- Contribute outside of the inbox via sharing suggestions and ideas for how we can improve.

- Successfully meet KPI targets and/or goals.

- Demonstrate Fin's Values in your work and alignment with the company vision and strategy.

What skills do I need?

- 3-4+ years of technical support experience, ideally within a software/SaaS environment.

- Solid understanding of tech fundamentals & modern day tools (Slack, Chrome, Coda, etc.)

- A basic understanding of APIs and webhooks, navigating developer documentation to know what is and isn’t possible with Fin's REST API.

- Strong customer focus (excels at & enjoys helping customers)

- Strong communication skills (ability to question, clarify, empathize, use appropriate tone & language, personable)

- Strong problem solving skills (ability to think critically and learn on-the-fly)

- Ability to troubleshoot and utilize resources to answer questions on baseline topics

- Ability to take on & action feedback, as well as deliver feedback consistently and at a high quality to peers, managers and cross-functional partners.

- Excitement for a support environment that has fully embraced AI solutions as the next step towards providing world-class customer support.

- Demonstrated success working with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) or other metrics/quotas.

Bonus skills & attributes

- Experience using Fin, or similar SaaS platforms.

- Experience as Tier 2 or similar level of support.

- Experience in coaching & mentoring teammates.

- Experience in helping customers make the most of their current subscriptions.

- Experience in using AI tools (Glean, ChatGPT, Gemini etc.) to troubleshoot customer issues.

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

- Are passionate about leveraging AI to enhance support experiences and drive team performance.

- See support as an exciting opportunity to solve daily customer related puzzles.

- Like finding ways to work smarter, not just harder.

- Are hungry to learn, iterate, and help build something great.

- Are excited by ownership, accountability and feedback—you don’t just do the work, you shape how it’s done, and are ok with sharing both constructive feedback & kudos about it.

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Seu Cardápio Diário:

- Atuar como especialista técnico mais sênior do time de Threat Intelligence, desenhando frameworks de coleta, metodologias de análise e práticas de inteligência que elevem a qualidade e o rigor dos produtos entregues.

- Desenvolver e manter uma base de conhecimento de threat actors específica do ecossistema bancário e de pagamentos, acompanhando a evolução de banking trojans, famílias de malware financeiro, ofertas de fraud-as-a-service e mercados criminosos.

- Desenhar e implementar capacidades avançadas de coleta, incluindo extração de indicadores técnicos, infraestrutura customizada de scraping e pipelines de fusão de dados.

- Proficiência em scripting e automação para processamento de inteligência, utilizando Python, PowerShell e Bash.

- Experiência com TIPs, APIs de enriquecimento, data lakes e ferramentas de visualização para fusão de dados de fontes distintas.

- Conhecimento sólido de telemetria de rede, hosts e fraude em pagamentos, com capacidade de identificar padrões e separar ruído de atividade relevante.

- Conhecimento avançado de perfilamento e atribuição de threat actors, incluindo análise de infraestrutura, classificação de famílias de malware, indicadores linguísticos e culturais, padrões de targeting e avaliação de confiança.

- Familiaridade profunda com fluxos de Incident Response e investigação de fraude.

- Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de produzir relatórios tecnicamente rigorosos e resumos acionáveis para públicos não técnicos.

- Experiência em desenhar e ensinar práticas de inteligência a profissionais juniores.

Para Realçar o Sabor:

- Vivência com infraestrutura de scraping customizada e pipelines de fusão de dados.

- Experiência com publicação de pesquisas, participação em conferências ou contribuição para a comunidade de Threat Intelligence.

- Conhecimento de STIX/TAXII, MISP, data lakes ou outras estruturas para operacionalização e compartilhamento de inteligência.

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
In Octopus Energy crediamo che le strutture burocratiche tradizionali rischino spesso di infantilizzare le persone e soffocare la creatività. Le persone adulte non hanno bisogno di rigide regole dall'alto, ma di autonomia, responsabilità e fiducia.
Non cerchiamo un HR tradizionale che imponga processi o "gestisca" le persone per conto dei manager. Cerchiamo una figura di People Operations capace di costruire strumenti e percorsi fluidi (come il nostro onboarding automatizzato) per rimuovere gli ostacoli e dare a ogni team il supporto per esprimersi al meglio fin dal primo giorno.

Gestione Contratti e Onboarding: Redazione e invio dei contratti di lavoro ai nuovi assunti, monitorando con cura lo stato di avanzamento della documentazione necessaria all’ingresso in azienda.

Supporto ai Team Leader: Gestione operativa delle richieste quotidiane, delle segnalazioni e degli aggiornamenti provenienti dai Team Leader.

Anagrafiche e Gestione Sistemi: Mantenimento e aggiornamento costante dei profili dei colleghi sui nostri sistemi gestionali (cambi di ruolo, variazioni contrattuali).

Miglioramento dei Processi & Automazioni: Contributo attivo all’ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro, alla creazione/manutenzione di template operativi e all'implementazione di automazioni.

Riservatezza e Cura dei Dati: Garanzia che ogni processo amministrativo e informativo sia gestito con massima cura, precisione e rispetto della riservatezza.

Progetti Amministrativi e Supporto Trasversale: Supporto operativo a progetti speciali o ad altre attività amministrative in base alle esigenze del team.

Ottime capacità comunicative: ottima proprietà di linguaggio sia scritta che orale, fondamentale per interagire con trasparenza con colleghi e stakeholder.

Organizzazione e dettaglio: spiccata attenzione ai dettagli, precisione impeccabile e capacità di organizzare le proprie priorità in modo autonomo.

Serietà e riservatezza: Elevata sensibilità nella gestione di informazioni riservate e dati personali.

Attitudine digitale: familiarità con strumenti digitali, software di gestione del personale o tool di produttività, unita alla capacità di imparare velocemente nuovi sistemi.

Spirito di squadra e proattività: attitudine collaborativa, capacità di anticipare i bisogni e orientamento pratico alla risoluzione dei problemi.

Flessibilità in ambienti dinamici: abilità nel muoversi con disinvoltura in un contesto in rapida crescita, flessibile e privo di burocrazia inutile.

Conoscenza di base di sistemi o procedure paghe (rappresenta un vantaggio apprezzato).

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati.Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

Sede: Ancarano/Ascoli Piceno

Ore: Tempo pieno

Presenza in ufficio: Si

Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.

Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.

jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.
In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.
Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più sostenibili, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Si tu postules, tu t’apprêtes à rejoindre une société "noHR". En effet, nous n’avons pas une équipe "RH" au sens “classique” du terme.
Chez Octopus Energy, il n’y a pas de département RH centralisé. Et c’est souvent ce qui surprend le plus les personnes extérieures à Octopus.
 
Quand il n’y a pas de RH, tout le monde l'est : les managers sont responsables de leurs équipes, et l'équipe People Ops est là pour leur donner les bons outils, la bonne data et les bons réflexes pour être autonomes.
Pour ce poste, on cherche surtout quelqu’un qui aime la data people, les outils et les projets, avec une forte sensibilité technique et analytique.
Le cœur du rôle : structurer et industrialiser notre data people, pour donner aux managers une vision claire, fiable et actionnable de leurs équipes, tout en prenant en main des projets People Ops très variés : déploiement d’outils, automatisation, documentation, sujets conformité ou projets Groupe.
La partie admin / paie existe aussi, mais elle est moins centrale : il faut pouvoir comprendre ces sujets, aider ponctuellement l’équipe et apprendre au fil de l’eau.

-
Construire et faire vivre notre data people

Tu nous aideras à transformer nos données people en indicateurs clairs, fiables et actionnables pour nos managers.

Concrètement, tu pourras :

-
construire des tableaux de bord pour les managers et l’équipe People ;

-
consolider des données venant de plusieurs outils : Hibob, Silae, Elevo, Google Sheets, LMS, etc. ;

-
fiabiliser les données et identifier les incohérences ;

-
automatiser des reportings, exports ou contrôles récurrents tout en les rendants facilement maintenables pour le futur ;

-
aider les managers à lire et utiliser la data people sans créer d’usine à gaz ;

-
traduire un besoin opérationnel parfois flou en indicateurs utiles.

On ne cherche pas juste quelqu’un qui sait sortir des chiffres. On cherche quelqu’un qui sait rendre la data people vraiment utile.

-
Piloter des projets People Ops / outils

Tu prendras aussi en main des projets People Ops variés : déploiement d’outils, automatisations, documentation, sujets conformité, etc.

L’idée : partir d’un besoin parfois flou, comprendre le problème, proposer une solution simple et la faire avancer avec les bonnes personnes.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter ou contribuer au déploiement d’outils ;

-
automatiser ce qui peut l’être ;

-
documenter clairement les règles et bonnes pratiques ;

-
travailler avec les équipes People, les managers, le groupe et les équipes opérationnelles.

-
Aider sur l’admin / paie

La paie et l’administration RH font partie de l’environnement du poste, mais ce n’est pas le cœur du rôle.

Tu pourras aider l’équipe sur certains sujets ADP / paie, notamment pour fiabiliser les données, améliorer les exports ou répondre à des questions People simples.

Pas besoin d’être expert·e paie dès le départ : on pourra te former. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ta capacité à comprendre, structurer, fiabiliser et améliorer.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si :

-
tu as une expérience solide, au moins 7 ans, en People Analytics, HRIS, People Ops, projets people, paie / ADP, outils SIRH ;

-
Tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel : formules, croisements de fichiers, contrôles, tableaux de bord ;

-
tu sais rendre une donnée lisible et utile pour des managers ;

-
tu aimes les outils SIRH : les tester, les paramétrer, les challenger, les améliorer ;

-
tu sais prendre un projet de A à Z et avancer avec autonomie ;

-
tu es pragmatique : tu préfères une solution simple qui marche à un process parfait que personne n’utilise ;

-
tu comprends les grands enjeux people opérationnels ;

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais (minimum B2-C1), car tu travailleras aussi avec des équipes groupe localisées au Royaume-Uni ;

-
tu as envie de faire autrement, dans une culture forte d’autonomie et de responsabilité.

jobs.title: Credit Specialist
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Sei una persona che sa gestire situazioni delicate con empatia e precisione? Stiamo cercando un Credit Specialist per aiutarci a supportare i nostri clienti e trovare il giusto equilibrio nei pagamenti. 

- Interagire con i clienti per recupero crediti.

- Analizzare la situazione finanziaria dei clienti e proporre piani di pagamento personalizzati e sostenibili.

- Supportare i clienti che si trovano in difficoltà economiche, identificando soluzioni tramite strumenti dedicati.

- Usare l’iniziativa per trovare la soluzione migliore, concordando piani di rimborso adeguati.

- Collaborare con i team interni e gli enti esterni (es. Agenzie di recupero crediti) per una gestione efficace del credito.

- Gestire comunicazioni e richieste tramite sistemi dedicati e garantire un servizio rapido ed efficiente.

- Monitorare le normative di settore e applicare le best practices per una gestione conforme e trasparente.

- Esperienza pregressa in un ruolo simile, preferibilmente nel settore energetico o finanziario.

- Capacità di analisi e attenzione ai dettagli, con un approccio orientato alla soluzione.

- Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali per interagire con clienti e colleghi.

- Attitudine al lavoro in un ambiente dinamico, con capacità di gestire priorità e scadenze.

- Conoscenza delle normative relative al credito e capacità di mantenersi aggiornato sulle evoluzioni del settore.

- Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza. Lavoriamo con autonomia e fiducia, crediamo che l’impegno vada riconosciuto con benefici che contano davvero per chi lavora con noi.

- Equity Options Scheme - possiedi la tua parte dell'azienda, opzioni di azioni nell'intero Octopus Energy Group: tutti lavoriamo insieme per il successo.

- Focus sul tuo benessere - ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

- Cultura dell'ufficio - ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti (questo avviene anche virtualmente) per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi - lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

jobs.title: EV Sales Specialist (B2C)
jobs.summary: What we do. Electric Car Leasing Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future. We’re expanding our Electric Vehicle Sales Team in Weybridge.
jobs.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.

We’re expanding our Electric Vehicle Sales Team in Weybridge. We're looking for an Electric Vehicles Sales Specialist, who will be responsible for managing sales directly with our customers focusing on our salary sacrifice product.  
 
You will be the face and the voice of the Octopus Electric Vehicles, advising and supporting customers throughout their journey towards purchasing an EV. You will discuss their requirements and find the perfect vehicle for their lifestyle, considering the salary sacrifice product fully and the benefits of going electric.  
 
We’re all about growth - both for the business and for our people. We provide plenty of opportunities for career progression, continuous learning, and personal development. Whether you're eager to level up your skills or thrive in our fast paced environment, we’re here to support your journey and help you make an impact.
 
A genuine passion for customer experience and sustainability is a must with a strong understanding of process and the importance of customer service.
 
This role will include an uncapped commission scheme and a generous car allowance as part of the overall package and will be based in our brand new office Weybridge 3 days a week.

- Speak to customers interested in leasing an electric vehicle and qualifying the right one for them

- Manage the end to end sales pipeline with customers - from lead through to delivery and deliver sales in line with targets

- Manage customer orders in progress and supervise order processing

- Continue planning and targeting of the acquisition of new customers

- Recording customer satisfaction to ensure that customers are having the best experience

- Provide excellent customer service both through the sales process and also in after-sales customer care

- Strategically build your pipeline working with the team to create strong relationships both with internal stakeholders as well as with our customers both on a consumer and business level

- Some sales experience welcome, whether that's in a customer-facing role, recruitment, or anywhere you've had to persuade, pitch, or close

- Experience in technology-driven sales processes (CRM, digital sales)

- Proven track record of working in a target driven role and providing excellent customer experiences

- Strong communication skills, a passionate drive, resilience, and a humble attitude

- An inquisitive nature with the ability to gather information to align customer needs with tailored solutions

- A genuine passion for going above and beyond for customers and a strong passion for Electric Vehicles, sustainability and/or the automotive industry

- A start up / entrepreneurial mind-set being able to adjust to change and keep up with a fast moving business

- A constant focus on improving and developing personally and within a business

- Ideally if you have previous experience within fleet, leasing or selling a salary sacrifice product - this is a bonus!

- Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

- Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits

- Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024, on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 and our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people

- Just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies!

jobs.description:
宇宙に「緑」の大穴をあけるために、力を貸してください！ 世界中で再生可能エネルギー革命を推進するミッションを実現するため、より多くの人の協力が必要なのです。

＜ご応募の際は日本語の職務経歴書をご提出ください＞

年次有給休暇23日／東京ガスと英国オクトパスエナジーの合弁会社

わたしたちは「グリーンな電力」をお手頃価格で提供地球に優しいグリーンな電力を手頃な価格で提供する会社です。
近年世界中で注目の「再生可能エネルギー」を日本にも普及させるため、2021年に東京ガスと電力会社オクトパスエナジーが共同出資して誕生しました。

＜わたしたちはこういう会社です＞
・出社と同時に自分の個性を包み隠さなくてはならないような職場ではなく、本来の自分でいられるような会社にしたい。なぜならその人物こそが我々が採用した人であり、ありのままの自分で同僚とやりとりしたり、お客様の応対をしてほしいから。その人の本質を尊重し、ありのままの自分で居られて、自ら創造性を高めて仕事に大いに貢献してもらえるような会社でありたい。そのためにも、社員がインスパイアされモチベーションを高められリラックスできる空間と合わせて、世界中の方々をお迎えする空間作りを行っている。
・オクトパスの原理は、昔の建築の石垣の原理。つまり、２つと無いユニークな形の自然石同士の合わせの良さで強度を持たせて、何千年も持ち堪えることができる仕組みを大事にしている。だからこそありのままの自分を出してほしい。
・自由と責任は比例する。みなさんには自由を持って働いてほしい。ソファに体をうずめて脚を投げ出した格好で仕事をしても良いし、好きな音楽を聴きながらでもいいし、服装も完全自由。休暇の申請も妥当なタイミングで良い。出勤退勤の打刻も必要無い。就業規則は最小限の内容。ただし自由には責任が伴う。自由と適切なプレッシャーを同時に味わいながら、常に昨日の自分よりも成長してほしいし邁進してほしい。
・負荷をかけるというと、大企業では「苦手なことをさせる」場合が多いが、オクトパスでは皆が得意分野に取り組んで、オリジナリティを活かす。それこそが組織の強靭化につながる。なので、ITがやりたいならITを、営業なら営業、企画なら企画、好きなことで最大限あなたの力を活かしてほしい。そしていま私たちは、カスタマーサービスがやりたい人を探している。
・ミスは表彰する。ミスが起きたとき、ミスをミスと認めることが肝要。そしてそれを責めず、寛容さをもって受け入れる。時には表彰して茶化す(笑)。皆が皆理由があってここにいるのだから、皆で支え合うのが当たり前。

- 週休二日制です。
- オペレーション部門にて、日本のお客様をサポートするすべての業務の中心となっていただきます。
- お客様が直面するすべての問題に全責任を持ち、エンド・ツー・エンドのカスタマーサービスを提供します。
- もう、お客様が部署間をたらい回しにされるようなことはありません。
- 顧客体験のあらゆる側面について完全に訓練され、業界全体のトレーニングが提供されます。
- お客様からの問い合わせに全責任を持ち、適切な解決策を提供できるようになることが期待されます。
- 予想外のことも想定してください。
- エネルギーの経験は必要ありません。オクトパスではこれまでとは異なるやり方をしますので、必ずしも役立つとは限りません！主体性のある方を求めています。柔軟でダイナミックな機会を探している方なら学歴・年齢不問。新卒の方でも、子育て中の方でも、フレキシブルでダイナミックなお仕事をお探しの方なら大歓迎です。

- 日本のお客様へ電話サポートができるレベルの日本語力 - わたしたちは日本のお客様に日本語でサポートとサービスを提供しています。トレーニングも日本語で行われます。そのため日本語の読み書き、および会話が今現在すでに流暢な方でなければ、日本でのエナジースペシャリストの仕事は難しいです。
- カスタマーサポートへの情熱 - お客様は私たちのすべての活動の中心です。オクトパスエナジーでは、CEOからデータ・サイエンティストに至るまで、社員全員がお客様と接しています。オクトパスエナジーが、エネルギーサプライヤーとしてお客様に感動と興奮を与え続けられるために、地の果てまで赴くことがあなたの主な責任となります。
- オープンマインド - わたしたちは急成長中の企業であり、時にはうまくいかないこともあります。何事も学習曲線と捉え、積極的に弱点を発見し、解決策を提案し、顧客体験を改善することが期待されます。
- 親しみやすい - オペレーション部門はもちろん、オクトパスではチームワークを大切にしています。オクトパスでは、チームの全員が常にお互いをサポートし、助け合い、チームプレーヤーであることが期待されます。
- インクルーシブ（排他的じゃない） - オクトパスが成長し、業界を変革し続けるために、わたしたちの組織はあらゆるバックグラウンドを持つ、熱意と個性にあふれた多様な人材で構成されています。そして素晴らしいインクルーシブな企業文化を築き続けたいと考えています。排他的な考えをしがちな人には不向きな仕事です。
- 持続可能性への献身 - 再生可能エネルギーを供給する立場として、気候変動との闘いにおいて自分自身の生活の中でできる限りの支援をし、未来に良い影響を与えることに深くコミットしていただきます。
- 改善へのコミットメント - 今回募集するエナジースペシャリストという仕事はお客様との主な窓口であり、エナジー・スペシャリストの意見や提案は顧客体験に大きな影響を与えています。ですので、顧客体験を改善する方法を積極的に探し、発言することを恐れない人材を求めています。
- 仕事に対する強い倫理観 - オペレーションの仕事は非常にペースが速く、時には困難なこともあります。言い訳したくなる事もあるでしょう。しかしわたしたちは、困難な状況に対処して目標達成のために懸命に努力することで、自分の将来に責任を持てる人材を求めています。取得した経験やスキルや仲間からの信頼は、すべてあなた個人の財産です。

- 勤務地：東京都港区六本木１−４−５アークヒルズサウスタワー１８階
- 交通：東京メトロ南北線「六本木一丁目駅」より徒歩１分
- 勤務時間：フレックスタイム制（標準労働7.5時間）＊9:00-17:00は電話対応がある時間帯なのでこの時間帯に従事できることを期待されます。残業は月平均10〜20時間
- 年間休日：121日
- 週休2日制。六本木のオフィスへ出勤していただきます。
- 年末年始休暇
- 年次有給休暇は入社初日から23日間付与します
- 産休・育休
- 介護休暇
- 慶弔休暇
- 上司判断による追加の有給休暇もあります

jobs.summary: Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools.
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join us as Social Media Manager Italy to define and execute Qonto's social media strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube for the Italian market. You'll drive brand awareness, engagement, and customer acquisition through culturally resonant content, influencer collaborations, and data-driven campaigns. You will report to Marta Rifà Llimós, Head of Southern Europe Marketing.
➡️ What you'll do
Own the social strategy for Italy: Define the channel mix, content types (entertainment, product, educational, corporate), and calendar across IG, LinkedIn, and YouTube — with full autonomy.
Build and run the content calendar: Coordinate the monthly publishing plan across Design, Press, Events, PMM, Community, and external agencies. You ensure on-time delivery and strategic coherence.
Create content hands-on: Shoot and edit video/photo content using CapCut, Edits, Figma, or similar tools. Be comfortable on camera — you bring Qonto's Italian brand to life through owned content.
Run paid social campaigns: Manage LinkedIn campaigns directly, coordinate Instagram paid with our Italian agency, and support YouTube Ads with the media team.
Track performance and evolve strategy: Extract KPIs, draw conclusions, and systematically apply learnings. You use data to evolve your approach, not just report on it.
➡️ What we're looking for
3 years as the in-house social media owner for an Italian brand — not agency-side. You've designed and executed the full channel strategy across IG, LinkedIn, and YouTube solo, without an account manager or team below you. B2B or scale-up experience strongly preferred
Italian copywriting excellence: sharp, error-free, culturally resonant. You localise, not translate. Perfect written and oral Italian and English.
Data fluency: You work with Sprout, Google Analytics, Looker Studio (or equivalents) and you can walk through a campaign's performance metric by metric and tell me what you changed as a result — not just that results were positive
Influencer management: You've run creator campaigns end-to-end — sourcing, briefing, negotiation, performance tracking. You've owned the full cycle.
Paid social experience: You've managed LinkedIn campaigns and can brief an agency on Instagram paid with clear objectives and creative direction.
➡️ What we can offer you
Full ownership of a market: You define Italy's social strategy and you execute it. No committee approvals — you own the output and the results.
A growing content playground: Podcast, influencer collaborations, events coverage, video production — the formats are expanding and you'll shape what comes next.
Cross-functional collaboration across Southern Europe: You'll work daily with Design, Press, Events, PMM, Community, and Qonto's global social media team. Marta's team covers Italy, Spain, and Portugal — three markets, shared learnings.
AI-first environment: Daily experimentation with AI tools is expected. You'll have access to the best tools on the market to evolve your craft.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Marta Rifà Llimós, Head of Marketing Southern Europe, based in Barcelona.
Her path? 10+ years in digital marketing across Southern European markets. About the Internship
 
WebFX is seeking an intern for our project managment team! Our ideal candidate is either a current college student or a recent college grad, with a history of strong academics, and an interest in pursuing a career related to project management. 
 
Internship Logistics: What to Know
 
This is an in-person internship, based at our riverside campus in Harrisburg, PA
This internship is flexible with hours and days - we will work with our interns to determine a schedule that is a mutual fit
Interns will enjoy their own work space and tech set-up at our office, along with the ability to wear jeans/casual dress to work each day
 
The Qualifications: Who You Are
 
Education
A Bachelor's Degree: Either in Progress or Completed All Majors Welcome!
GPA: 3.4 or above
 
Suggested Experience and Skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Exceptional eye for aesthetics and design
Top-notch organizational skills
Basic Excel/Google Docs skills
Classroom-level familiarity with website design concepts
Eagerness to learn and be trained!
 
Qualities and Traits
You're interested in the web, and like keeping up with new technology
You're professional, dependable, and self-motivated
You take pride in your work and always strive for high-quality results
You work with urgency and enjoy getting things done
You're proactive when it comes to solving problems
You're a lifelong learner, and are always looking to stretch and grow your skills
You love thinking both creatively and analytically, and love using data to make decisions
 
The Internship Responsibilities: What You'll Learn to Do
 
Under the guidance of senior-level mentors, interns in this position can expect to:
 
Work alongside our full-time project managers to assist them in various client web projects
Assist in planning and outlining project specifications for website build projects
Learn and implement UX best practices
Perform quality testing for website builds and launches - evaluating performance, functionality, UX, etc
Coordinate with our development and design teams, ensuring client projects are completed in a timely and efficient manner
